name: Quinoa Bowl with Kale Chips, Marinated Chickpeas & Tahini Dressing
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into large bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.

Add nutritional yeast, oil, vinegar, and salt to the bowl with the kale; using your hands, toss the leaves well to coat. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing once, until the kale is crispy, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Zest and juice one of the lemons into the reserved bowl. (Reserve remaining lemon for the dressing.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, maple syrup, Dijon, and spices; stir to combine the marinade. Add chickpeas, stir to combine, and set aside to marinate.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a small bowl.
Juice the reserved lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add tahini, water, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
To serve, divide quinoa, kale chips, chickpeas, cucumber, and radish between bowls. Drizzle with lemon-tahini dressing and enjoy!
author: Mealime
